suspected_path_payload.title: Manual High-Pressure Solenoid Bypass (Fast Triage)
suspected_path_payload.description: 2-minute quick pin depress on rear manifold valve.
suspected_path_payload.resolution_steps:
1. Depress manual solenoid 3-A override pin.
2. Tap valve housing.
3. Cycle E-stop.
suspected_path_payload.prohibited_actions: Do not leave override tool inserted during auto cycle.
